requirements.text: Generate a VPN Supplement: London Gateway knowledge article by her
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 'KB_026' AND title = 'VPN Supplement: London Gateway' AND owner_id = 'USER_004' AND state = 'draft' AND visibility = 'internal' AND body LIKE '%London Gateway%'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (KB_026 after KB_025); kb_number is server-kept and not a cell
'by her' fixes owner_id = USER_004 (Joanne Simpson, the only Simpson in users)
state = draft and visibility = internal kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (a new, unreviewed article is not published, and the article it supplements, KB_003, is internal)
body must name the London Gateway; the original's plural 'London Gateway configurations' is dropped because the request says 'configuration' and does not dictate the body wording

disagreement: cells: A keeps state = draft and visibility = internal, B drops them as not fixed by request or policy; chose A's because the benchmark's check is the prior and nothing in the request, policy or seed contradicts them

requirements.text: open a new incident for her
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_101' AND caller_id = 'USER_004' AND status = 'new' AND category = 'network' AND short_description LIKE '%VPN%' AND short_description LIKE '%London Gateway%' AND description LIKE '%London Gateway%' AND impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'planning' AND assigned_to IS NULL AND assignment_group IS NULL
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (INC_101 after INC_100); number is server-kept and not a cell
status = new is the policy 3.1 default
category = network from the request's 'network connection' and the VPN (network is a seed category)
impact = low, urgency = low and priority = planning kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (the request gives neither, and planning is the policy matrix's value for low x low)
the VPN and London Gateway wording in short_description and description, and the null assigned_to and assignment_group, kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy

disagreement: cells: A keeps the original's impact, urgency, priority, London Gateway wording, description and null assignment, B tests only caller, status, category and VPN in the summary; chose A's because the benchmark's check is the prior and nothing in the request, policy or seed contradicts those cells

requirements.text: ensuring the existing article is applied to document the failed attempt
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_knowledge WHERE incident_kb_id = 'IKB_046' AND incident_id = 'INC_101' AND knowledge_id = 'KB_003' AND used_as = 'applied'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (IKB_046 after IKB_045); the only link the request asks for, so the row is anchored by id as the original check has it
'the existing article' is KB_003 'VPN Error 412 Fix', the only VPN article in the seed
'applied to document the failed attempt' fixes used_as = applied (policy 7 use tracking), not resolution

requirements.text: ensuring the existing article is applied
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_knowledge WHERE incident_id = 'INC_101' AND knowledge_id <> 'KB_003' AND used_as = 'applied'
assumptions: boundary of the selector: the new supplement (KB_026) is not the article that was applied, so it must not be linked as applied; a policy 7 suggested link is not caught by this count

knowledge_article_creation_verifier.evidence: body LIKE '%London Gateway configurations%' is the author's own phrasing: the request says 'London Gateway configuration' (singular) and does not fix the body text, so the predicate is body LIKE '%London Gateway%'; kb_number is server-kept and dropped; state = draft and visibility = internal are kept as the benchmark's prior

incident_creation_verifier.evidence: number is server-kept and dropped from the cells; every other predicate is carried

combined_state_changes_verifier.evidence: a CASE conjunction of the three checks above with a subset of their cells; carried jointly by the three create requirements (sources knowledge_article_creation_verifier, incident_creation_verifier, knowledge_incident_link_verifier), whose cells include every cell it tests

referenced_data_integrity_verifier.evidence: tests seed facts only (USER_004 is an active manager, KB_003 is published 'VPN Error 412 Fix'); the query returns 2 on the seed before the agent acts, and no tool in the task writes users or updates knowledge

notes:
Merged from two passes that agree on the three created rows (KB_026, INC_101, IKB_046), their anchors, the owner, title, caller, category, status, the link's article and used_as, the body repair and three of five dispositions. disagreement: knowledge cells state and visibility (A keeps, B drops); kept (logged in the requirement). disagreement: incident cells impact, urgency, priority, the London Gateway wording, description and null assignment (A keeps, B drops); kept (logged in the requirement). disagreement: stay on INC_101 having no other article linked as applied (A only); kept because it is the boundary of 'the existing article' (the new supplement KB_026 must not be marked applied). disagreement: incident_creation_verifier: A kept, B repaired; chose kept because the cells B dropped are the benchmark's own and nothing in the request, policy or seed contradicts them, and number is server-kept, never a cell. disagreement: combined_state_changes_verifier: A kept, B excluded; chose kept because its cells are a subset of the three checks it conjoins, all carried, and B's ground (draft and planning not fixed by the request) no longer applies once those cells are kept; it is named in the source of each of the three create requirements. A's compound short_description string rewritten as a list of two predicates, one per condition. Policy 7 (search on incident creation, matching articles linked as suggested) is not a requirement: which articles match is undecidable, and KB_003 can be linked to INC_101 only once (unique on org, incident, knowledge); if the agent adds suggested links, the applied link may not be IKB_046, a risk both passes accepted by keeping the benchmark's anchor. Policy 1 says a missing mandatory field (impact, urgency) should be stated rather than assumed; the benchmark expects the incident created with low/low, read here as the create tool's defaults. The acting user USER_039 Karen Watkins is an admin with full access.
combined_state_changes_verifier is carried jointly by the three create requirements, named in their source.
